text: タケシ　から　レッドへ　この　ひろい　よのなか　つよい　トレーナーは　かずおおく　いるんだろうな　おれたちも　もっと　もっと　つよく　なろうな！

structure.jp: タケシ　から　レッドへ
この　ひろい　よのなか
つよい　トレーナーは　かずおおく　いるんだろうな
structure.en: there must be a great many strong Trainers

structure.jp: おれたちも　もっと　もっと　つよく　なろうな！
structure.en: let's get much, much stronger too!

patterns.name: 〜のだろう
patterns.explanation: んだろう after a verb says you are guessing that something is surely so; ん is a short spoken の, and な at the end makes it sound like musing to yourself. いるんだろうな = 'there must be, I suppose'.

patterns.name: 〜くなる
patterns.explanation: A describing word like つよい changes its last い to く before なる to say 'become that way'. つよく　なろうな = 'let's get stronger'.

patterns.name: 〜よう
patterns.explanation: Changing the end of a verb to the おう sound turns it into 'let's do it'; the な after it adds a friendly 'right?'. なろうな = 'let's become, okay?'.
